data.body: STOP/report: CL 2666 patch set 8 is ready from the scanner side (plan review PASS; local scanner/parity tests, lint, and typecheck pass; LLM-Review +1; unresolved comments 0), but Gerrit Verified is blocked by an unrelated current-main optionality canary failure: terraform-config-inspect pinned canary returns outcome abstain instead of match in tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py::test_pinned_upstream_canary. The same canary failed concurrently on unrelated CLs 2673 and 2674. One documented recheck was attempted after confirming it was not scanner/Verified wiring; it reproduced. I did not expand this scanner ticket to edit the unrelated Terraform canary because that requires human judgment/out-of-scope work.
